decisions: Record DriveWealth/Ripple as an announced integration in progress, not verified live production.
Record RLUSD on XRPL as the announced stablecoin settlement asset for Europe; US expansion is planned.
Record Ripple Payments cross-border acceptance, Europe digital-asset custody and Ripple Prime Delta One equity-financing exploration as separate workstreams.
Stablecoin-funded collateral accounts do not establish native XRP collateral or XRP bridge demand.
Admit no market feature and issue no directional forecast until production transaction, collateral and asset-level data are verified.
required_verification: Verify DriveWealth production cutover and RLUSD daily settlement volume.
Obtain XRPL transaction hashes, Ripple Mint issuance/redemption and fee-burn observations attributable to DriveWealth integration.
Verify eligible collateral assets, haircuts, balances and cash-conversion volumes.
Determine whether any workflow requires XRP as bridge asset versus only XRPL network fees.
